subject: Consulting Partner Certification Roadmap — proposed
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai (Lauren Bishop)
To: ben.dahlia@dahlia-consulting.com, elena.rodriguez@claritytech.io
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consulting Partner Certification Roadmap — proposed

Hi Ben / Elena,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week — we left wanting a clear, lightweight certification path your consultants can complete before leading customer PoCs. Attached is a first-draft roadmap we use for SI partners; I tailored it to the consulting model you described. High-level summary below.

What this includes (attached):
- 8-week certification syllabus (redwood-partner-cert-syllabus.pdf)
- 3-day hands-on lab curriculum and calendar (partner-curriculum-calendar.xlsx)
- Suggested co-sell incentives and success metrics (redwood-co-sell-incentive-summary.pdf)

Core phases (proposed):
1) Fundamentals (self-paced, 4 modules) — platform concepts, API usage, cost controls, security baseline
2) Hands-on labs (2 instructor-led half-days + sandbox exercises) — sample demos, inference tuning, batching/caching patterns
3) Certification exam + PoC badge (proctored 60-minute exam + mini-PoC)
4) Quarterly recertification lite (3 modules, automated)

Proposed delivery model: a mix of self-serve LMS content + two instructor-led workshops per quarter. We can host a dedicated sandbox for Dahlia for 90 days during ramp.

Open questions for you:
- Target cohort size for the first run?
- Preference for public workshop dates or a private training block?
- Are you aiming to brand the badge/co-marketing?

Next steps I recommend:
- Confirm target cohort and target go-live date (we can start content staging next week)
- I’ll loop in Camila for curriculum logistics and Sergio for commercial incentives

Attachments: redwood-partner-cert-syllabus.pdf; partner-curriculum-calendar.xlsx; redwood-co-sell-incentive-summary.pdf

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Head of Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

--
From: ben.dahlia@dahlia-consulting.com (Ben Dahlia)
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: elena.rodriguez@claritytech.io, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consulting Partner Certification Roadmap — proposed

Lauren — thanks, this looks promising. A few quick clarifying items: 

1) Cohort size: we’re planning an initial cohort of 6 senior consultants (3 ML engineers + 3 solution architects). If the first run goes well, we’ll scale to ~20 per quarter.
2) Branding: yes — we’d like a co-branded badge and one joint blog post announcing the partnership after the first PoC.
3) Sandboxes: 90 days is fine, but can you confirm whether the sandbox is dedicated (VPC) or shared with rate limits? We have clients with strict data isolation requirements.

Also, can we sync on pricing/discounts for partner delivery? Elena, looping you to confirm availability for a kickoff next Friday (24th) at 11am PT.

Thanks,
Ben
Principal, Partnerships
Dahlia Consulting
ben.dahlia@dahlia-consulting.com

Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consulting Partner Certification Roadmap — proposed

Ben / Lauren — happy to run point on the curriculum delivery. A few clarifications from the enablement side: 

- Exam format: multiple-choice + 1 scenario-based practical (we provide a template PoC rubric).
- Hands-on lab infra: we can offer a dedicated VPC sandbox during the 90-day ramp for Dahlia’s cohort; we’ll need an MSA addendum for that (security & data handling).
- Instructor resourcing: we can staff two sessions in the first month (instructor: Marissa Cole).

Ben — for pricing: I suggest a partner onboarding bundle that includes 90-day sandbox access + two instructor-led workshops + certification exams for the 6-person cohort. Draft price = $18,000 net; we can offer a performance-based rebate if Dahlia delivers 2 closed PoCs within 90 days (rebate mechanics in attached PDF).

Proposed actions:
- Ben: confirm cohort and approve bundle pricing or propose alternate commercial terms
- Lauren: if approved, I’ll prepare course links and calendar invites

Camila Reyes
Director, Partner Enablement
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

On Thu, Sep 16, 2027 at 10:03 AM Ben Dahlia <ben.dahlia@dahlia-consulting.com> wrote:

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai (Sergio Alvarez)
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, camila.reyes@redwood.ai, ben.dahlia@dahlia-consulting.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consulting Partner Certification Roadmap — proposed

Team — I support the $18k bundle but want to tighten the success metrics and incentives. Proposed changes: 

- Tiered rebate: 10% rebate if Dahlia closes 1 PoC within 90 days, 25% rebate if 3+ PoCs closed within 90 days.
- Co-sell credit: we’ll give a one-time $2,500 co-sell credit per qualified deal registered through the partner portal (credited against future invoices).
- Certification pass threshold: 80% on the multiple-choice + pass on the scenario rubric.

I’ll update the co-sell paperwork and add the incentive language to the partner addendum. Camila — can you confirm instructor availability week of Oct 4 for a private delivery?

—Sergio
